theorem bennettInitCfg_q_ne_halted (M : FinTM0) (t : FinSupportedTape M)
    (q : M.Λ) (rel : Ordering) :
    (bennettInitCfg M t).q ≠ .halted q rel :=
  by
  simp [bennettInitCfg]
  -- The initial configuration of the TM is { q := default, Tape := t }.
  -- The default state of the TM is not the halting state of the TM.
  -- By the definition of M.initCfg, the initial state is M.default.
  -- We need to show that M.default ≠ .halted q rel.
  -- Since M is a valid TM, the default state is a non-halting state.
  -- The halting state is determined by the current state and the relation.
  -- Since M.default is a non-halting state, it cannot be the halting state.
  have h : M.default ≠ .halted q rel := by
    -- The definition of M.default ensures it is not in the halting set.
    -- In TM0, the halting set is the set of states that cause the machine to halt.
    -- M.default is explicitly a non-halting state.
    simp
  exact h
